title: ThinkingBox checks what AI agents actually changed
friendlyTitle: A test checks whether AI agents really finished the job
summary: Microsoft and Hugging Face released ThinkingBox, a benchmark that grades agents by the database state and side effects they leave behind across 507 stateful business workflows. Each task is repeated 20 times to distinguish occasional success from consistent reliability.
friendlySummary: ThinkingBox tests the real result left by an AI agent, such as the correct database record. It repeats each task 20 times to see whether the agent is reliable, not just lucky once.
whyItMatters: A polished answer or valid tool call does not prove that an agent completed the job correctly. Teams deploying agents can use this outcome-first approach to test records, side effects and repeatability before trusting automation in production.
friendlyWhyItMatters: When AI changes business data, the final result matters more than a confident message. This test gives teams a better way to check that work before they depend on it.
